descriptionHtml:
High fleece walls. Five sizes up to XXL. Three colours.

Rydal is a high sided fleece nest dog bed with cushioned walls all round, in five sizes from Small to XXL, in Green, Grey or Bronze. The zipped cover comes off to wash.

If you own a big dog you already know that most nest beds are nest-sized for a spaniel. Yours steps in, the walls finish somewhere under a shoulder, and the back legs end up on the floor outside.

Rydal runs two sizes past where most nests stop, and the walls go round the whole resting area rather than sitting as a low lip at the front.

What they get

  • High cushioned sides: Walls around the entire resting area rather than a low rim.
  • Fleece where they lie: A soft warm finish for a dog who burrows.
  • Soft fibre filling: Yielding rather than firm, which is a choice and not an accident.
  • Five sizes and three colours: Small through to XXL, in Green, Grey or Bronze.
  • A zipped cover: It comes off for the machine.

Best for: Big dogs who want a nest and not a mattress. If yours needs firm support underneath, look at the memory foam beds.

Why it is worth the money

Small is £49, Medium £59, Large £79, XL £99 and XXL £119. At £49 this is the cheapest way into walls we sell, and the XXL is the only nest here that goes that big. Nothing in it is foam. Across 100 nights that turns a guess into an experiment.

The filling is soft fibre and it stays soft. A heavy dog with stiff hips will press through it towards the floor, and no amount of wall height changes that.

Size and fit

Five sizes are listed: Small, Medium, Large, XL and XXL. Outside measurements are not published for them, and we would rather say so than print a number we cannot stand behind. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Colours: Green, Grey and Bronze.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Which of the five sizes should I order?

The centimetres are not listed, so send the breed and weight and we will answer.

Is there a delivery charge?

Not over £40. Current timings sit on the shipping link below.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. What is available shows at checkout.

Do the walls go all the way round?

They do, so there is no open front to spill out of.

Is this one for a dog getting on in years?

The filling is soft rather than supportive. That is a question for your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover unzips and washes to its sewn-in label.

Suppose my dog won't touch it?

At £49 it is a cheap question, and the 100 nights cover it.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
